# Bug Report Template

Use this as the starting point for `BUG_REPORT.md` in the Summative.

Document each important defect you fixed.

## Bug Summary

State the bug clearly.

## Why It Matters

Explain the system or user impact.

## Root Cause

Describe what caused the defect.

## Regression Evidence

Link the test or evidence that proves the issue is fixed.

## Residual Risk

Explain anything still weak or not yet covered.
